scope: All 108 names: the text was compared name by name with the page images of the TTD book (pp. 36–38), and every meaning was read against its name. There are no word-by-word glosses on this page (the meanings are per name). The range-number flags are the block labels. Readings the print shares with no other list are kept and listed in SOURCES §12.2.

items.issue: Names 12, 30 and 85 were given as śucyai, buddhyai, siddhyai; the print has śucaye, buddhaye, siddhaye.
Name 103 read sarvopadravavāriṇyai; the print has sarvopadravanivāriṇyai (a syllable had dropped out). Name 105 is printed mahākāḷyai.
Name 28, krodhasambhavāyai (“born of wrath”), is the print's reading, but most lists have kṣīrodasambhavāyai; the meaning gave no hint of that.
items.change: The meaning now mentions the other reading.
